name: Direct Buy Without Clearing Cart – WooCommerce Buy Now Button
author: Aashish khambu

sections.description:
Direct Buy Without Clearing Cart is a lightweight, powerful plugin for WooCommerce that enables customers to go directly to the checkout page with a selected product — while keeping their existing cart items untouched.

Perfect for upselling, promotions, or fast-purchase flows, this plugin ensures smooth user experience and higher conversion rates, without breaking the shopping session.

Unlike other direct checkout plugins, this one keeps the customer’s cart safe and intact.

🔥 Why Use This Plugin?

  • Keep existing cart items even after a “Buy Now” click
  • Ideal for upsells, flash sales, and one-click promos
  • Save time and reduce checkout friction
  • Supports deep-linking to specific products via URL

🎯 Perfect For

  • Flash sales or limited-time offers
  • One-product WooCommerce stores
  • Email or SMS campaigns with “Buy Now” CTAs
  • Affiliate marketing and ad landing pages
  • Stores using bundles, add-ons, or upsell flows

⚙️ Features

  • 🚀 Skip the cart and go directly to checkout
  • 🛒 Cart-safe: does not clear previous cart items
  • 🔗 Link to direct buy via: /?direct-buy-product=123
  • 🎨 Customizable button text and styles
  • 🍪 Cookie-based tracking for smarter behavior
  • 💬 Lightweight and compatible with all major themes
  • 💼 Premium support and updates (optional)

🛠 Installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/direct-buy-single-product, or install it from the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Use a link like:
    https://yoursite.com/?direct-buy-product=123
    Replace 123 with your product ID.

🖼 Screenshots

  1. “Buy Now” button on a product page
  2. Plugin settings panel

❓ FAQ

Can I customize the button text or style?

Yes! You can adjust text and style via the plugin settings.

Does it delete existing items from the cart?

No. That’s the main benefit — your existing cart stays untouched.

Does it support variable products?

Current version supports simple products only. Variations support is planned.

Can I use this for campaign links or affiliate promos?

Absolutely. Just create a custom link with the ?direct-buy-product= URL.

📌 Changelog

1.8

  • Improved cart preservation behavior
  • Cleaned up UI and button styling options

1.0.0

  • Initial release

🚀 Upgrade Notice

1.8

Recommended upgrade for improved performance and better compatibility.
